newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan-Mar industrial output seen up 3.0%-MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan-Mar industrial output seen up 3.0%-MITI.

text.p: Japan's industrial production in the January-March period is seen rising 3.0 percent from the previous quarter, an official of the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Wednesday.
The figure compared with a quarter-on-quarter rise of 3.3 percent in the October-December quarter.
The official said retail sales in the January-March quarter were seen rising 7.9 percent from the same period a year earlier.
